# Victor Lindahl

Data protection officer of the institute. He sits on the [[data-governance-board-membership|data governance board]] as a standing member and signs off every data protection impact assessment.

## Role

Victor wrote the [[registry-linkage-dpia-summary|DPIA for the registry linkage]], signed off on 2025-09-18, and is writing the DPIA for the consortium transfer clause ([[consortium-transfer-dpia-draft]]). His sign-off is the gate for the [[data-access-policy-revision]] at the November board.

## How We Work Together

He is precise and helpful if you bring him a data flow diagram rather than a description. [[yara-castellanos]] and he work well together; most of our requests reach him through her. He will not accept "anonymised" for anything that has a key somewhere, and he is right; his framing is captured in [[pseudonymisation-vs-anonymisation]].

His position on cfDNA: fragment-level data from a single person, even without germline variants, is personal data while a key exists. He is open to treating aggregate feature tables with small-cell suppression as lower risk. See [[is-fragment-level-cfdna-data-personal-data]].

## Current Threads

- Receiving-site assessment for the consortium DPIA: he wants a short questionnaire answered by each Halo site; [[eva-novak]] is collecting the answers.
- Review of the federated alternative for [[federated-cfdna-learning]]; he sees it as lower risk but notes model updates can still leak.

## History With The Group

Victor first worked with the group on the [[lab-data-management-plan]] in 2025, when he insisted that legacy Northvale extracts move off general cluster storage into the institute secure data environment. That was inconvenient at the time and has since saved several questions from the board. The registry linkage DPIA went through in about eight weeks, which he regards as fast.

For the consortium clause, he has said he needs the receiving sites' answers before he can sign, and that he will not sign a DPIA that describes environments he has not seen evidence for. That is the main dependency for the 2026-11-12 board, and the reason Ines and [[eva-novak]] are chasing the last two Halo site questionnaires.
